title: Query
description: A link to a set of things, written as a rule instead of a list. Names a content type (or `field`, `template`, `contentType`, or `action` in an actions display group) and a `where` condition evaluated against each candidate as `item`. Queries that refer only to `item` are resolved once by loadRuleset after all packs are merged; queries that refer to the character run during computeSheet and listOptions.

type.description: A content type name, or one of the built-in kinds `field`, `template` and `action` (an actions display group's members).
